455:t_3:95.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$アクエリオン$$'s power is the power of feelings... Perhaps the rest of you should be more honest, too.」

455:t_3:97.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's wrong? Worried about your sister?」

455:t_3:98.en:
$$シリウス$$
「No... It's about that $$ミカゲ$$...」

455:t_3:99.en:
$$シュレード$$
「As for where he's gone, the other half of his soul and Supreme Commander $$不動$$ are tracking him. There's nothing to do but wait.」

455:t_3:101.en:
$$シリウス$$
(I, who once became an $$天翅$$ myself, understand...)

455:t_3:102.en:
$$シリウス$$
(The hatred of that $$堕天翅$$ called $$ミカゲ$$ was not aimed only at us...)

455:t_3:103.en:
$$シリウス$$
(What does he hate...? And where is it headed...?)

455:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$ランド$$. You always look drained after a match with $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

455:t_10:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「For the sake of my mental health, I need to settle things with her ASAP.」

455:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, I very much welcome how faithful she is to her desires.」

455:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The exhilaration she felt when she fought $$ミカゲ$$ generated 100Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

455:t_10:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Exhilaration, huh... Wouldn't she be the only one who finds it fun to fight a guy like that?」

455:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of such a taste for the bizarre. It's beyond ordinary comprehension.」

455:t_10:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey! Hold on, AG! What's that supposed to mean!?」

455:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Excuse me. It's almost business hours at the $$Ｄトレーダー$$, so I'll be going~」

455:t_10:17.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「...We've been so busy that we haven't had much time to talk, but you and I are a past life and its reincarnation, aren't we?」

455:t_10:18.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah... Although we don't look much alike, like $$アポロ$$ and $$カグラ$$ said.」

455:t_10:19.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Isn't that fine? I'm me, and you're you, $$ミコノ$$.」

455:t_10:21.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Besides... if we looked exactly alike, I'd worry that $$アマタ$$ would start eyeing someone else...」

455:t_10:22.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「You two are so lovey-dovey, and you're still worried?」

455:t_10:23.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Well, $$アマタ$$ was... a fan of $$シルフィ$$ in '《$$アクエリアの舞う空$$》'...」

455:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Allow me to explain. '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$' is a grand love story set in the war between humanity and the $$堕天翅$$.」

455:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly. The lead is $$アポロン$$, otherwise known as $$アポロ$$, and the love interest is $$シルフィ$$, otherwise known as $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_10:28.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I-I can't believe something like that exists...」

455:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Amused, $$アルト$$ and the others are already trying to show it to $$アポロ$$, but...」

455:t_10:30.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「S-stop it! Even if it's made up, something like that...!」

455:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The screening is in the $$クォーター$$'s briefing room. I'd say it's probably started by now...」

455:t_10:34.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Y-yeah...! I'll show you the way!」

455:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... $$シルヴィア$$...! You still have the induction ceremony...!」

455:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well... never mind... There's no need to rush.」

455:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, I'll handle things myself for the first time in a while! Let's give it everything again today... business, business!」

455:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haa... This really does feel good, doesn't it...」

456:t_001:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You've got some nerve, washed-up $$堕天翅$$! Guys! Give 'em some payback!」

456:t_002:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice, nice! Fighting something inhuman gets my heart racing, too!」

456:t_002:1.en:
$$レズン$$
「Tch! So the $$ザフト$$ bunch has been wiped out!」

456:t_002:2.en:
$$レズン$$
(I know that teaming up with the Empire to survive couldn't be helped...)

456:t_002:3.en:
$$レズン$$
(But, $$フル・フロンタル$$...! I don't like your nerve in using the $$シャア・アズナブル$$ faction and $$ザフト$$ as bullet shields...!)

456:t_002:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well then, let's go, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ warriors! You're going to fight to protect that $$蒼の地球$$!」

456:t_002:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sinful one. Do you intend to commit the further sin of raising your sword against me?」

456:t_002:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If I worried about stuff like that, I couldn't enjoy a fight!」

456:t_002:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How foolish, $$サイデリアル$$... You people cannot be saved.」

456:t_002:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「While the washed-up $$堕天翅$$ is busy posing, it looks like a walk-in guest has shown up.」

456:t_003:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed: the $$堕天翅$$ and Empire forces are engaged! The Empire forces include $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

456:t_003:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Their Supreme Commander, $$エルーナルーナ$$, is out on the front line!」

456:t_003:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the setup is $$ミカゲ$$, who's after the $$蒼の地球$$, against the $$新地球皇国$$, who are stopping him.」

456:t_003:4.en:
$$メール$$
「But $$エルーナルーナ$$'s underlings aren't here!」

456:t_003:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「That works for us. If $$ダバラーン$$ shows up, things get complicated.」

456:t_003:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I knew it. Darling wants a date with me without $$ダバラーン$$ getting in the way, too.」

456:t_003:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「By 'date,' you mean trying to kill each other.」

456:t_003:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aha! You really do get me, Darling!」

456:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「She hasn't changed a bit.」

456:t_003:10.en:
$$桂$$
「Even I, who's used to being chased by girls, feel for $$ランド$$ this time.」

456:t_003:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What happened to $$ダバラーン$$ and $$ハイアデス$$? Did you fire them for losing at $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$?」

456:t_003:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No, no! It's an order from $$アウストラリス$$, who says there's no need to throw the elite into a fight like this.」

456:t_003:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't get so mad. It wouldn't be exciting otherwise, so I used my Supreme Commander authority and came out myself, didn't I?」

456:t_003:15.en:
$$レズン$$
(So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is being used as expendable pawns...!)

456:t_003:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is the Empire's way, Ensign $$レズン$$. Being the successors of Earth's humanity under their name means nothing at all.」

456:t_003:17.en:
$$レズン$$
「You've got no right to dictate how we live, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

456:t_003:18.en:
$$クェス$$
「If you keep being that stubborn, nothing will ever change...!」

456:t_003:19.en:
$$レズン$$
「I'll change it...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will change the world!」

456:t_003:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units! The battle will be a three-way struggle among us, the Empire forces, and the $$堕天翅$$!」

456:t_003:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What we must do now is defend the $$蒼の地球$$! Set the black $$アクエリオン$$ as our top-priority target!」

456:t_003:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s in the starting lineup!?」

456:t_003:25.en:
$$シン$$
「Did something happen to $$カイエン$$!?」
